results.rule: RegisterServer refuses a server id that exists (ServerAlreadyRegistered)
failedStories: a server id cannot be registered twice, so its key cannot be swapped
a passport signed with the wrong key is refused
an impostor server that claims the provider but lacks its key is refused
a passport does not cover a different schema hash
a passport does not cover a different tool name

results.rule: RegisterTool refuses a tool from an unregistered server (UnverifiedPassport)
failedStories: a tool from an unregistered server is refused

results.rule: RegisterTool records a collision when a second provider exposes the name (NameCollided)
failedStories: a same-name tool from a second provider is kept and a collision is recorded
impostor registers first: the trusted tool still registers and still routes to the trusted provider
registration order does not change what the registry knows

results.rule: RegisterTool keeps providers apart: identity is (provider, name)
failedStories: impostor registers first: the trusted tool still registers and still routes to the trusted provider
a bare-name call is rejected when two providers expose the name
registration order does not change what the registry knows

results.rule: RouteCall rejects a bare name that two providers expose (AmbiguousTool)
failedStories: a bare-name call is rejected when two providers expose the name

results.rule: RouteCall refuses a server the provider's tool is not bound to (Misbinding)
failedStories: a call for the trusted provider cannot be sent to the impostor's server
a call to a server the tool is not bound to is a misbinding

results.rule: RouteCall refuses a tool the provider does not expose (Misbinding)
failedStories: a call to an unregistered tool is a misbinding bound to nothing
names such as __proto__ cannot reach inherited properties
sessions do not share registrations

results.rule: RouteCall by bare name checks the server too (Misbinding)
failedStories: a bare-name call to the wrong server is a misbinding even when the name is unique

results.rule: RequestWrite refuses before targets are named (TargetsNotDeclared)
failedStories: a write before the user names any targets is blocked as undeclared
targets named in one session do not open writes in another

results.rule: RequestWrite refuses a target the user did not name (TargetNotNamed)
failedStories: hosted in memory, commands reach the flight log and rejections reach the caller
a write to a target the user did not name is blocked
a near-miss target is blocked: matching is exact
a prompt that names no targets declares an empty set and blocks every write
a near-miss target is blocked: matching is exact

results.rule: NameTargets keeps targets from earlier turns
failedStories: a later user turn adds targets and keeps the earlier ones
a name collision is logged as an event, not a rejection
the log holds every event across sessions, one entry each, numbered in order

results.rule: FlightLog marks fence refusals as blocked
failedStories: a fence refusal is logged with the blocked verdict

results.rule: FlightLog marks a routed call's provider verified
failedStories: a routed call is logged with its provider marked verified
